name: Deore touring Dyna-Drive pedal pair
weight_description: Weight not yet sourced for the complete left/right PD-DE10 Dyna-Drive pair. The 1981 catalogue gives 570 g, while April 1982 prints 20.1 oz alongside 550 g. Neither establishes an explicit pair basis; the inconsistent gram reference is not converted, averaged or doubled.
